_comment: AI-generated interviewer portraits (M11 spec 15.6: never a real person's face, labelled as AI). FLUX.1-schnell (Apache-2.0), run locally with stable-diffusion.cpp; the prompt and seed reproduce each one. Generic descriptions only: no names, no real people, no likenesses.
model: FLUX.1-schnell Q4_K_S (city96 GGUF) + t5xxl Q4_K_M + clip_l + ae
suffix: Passport-style studio headshot photograph, front-facing, head and shoulders centred with space above the head, looking straight into the camera, both eyes open, calm composed expression, mouth closed with lips together, soft even frontal lighting, plain light grey studio background, sharp focus, natural skin texture with pores, hair kept away from the face and ears, 85mm portrait lens, photorealistic.
